The '''Shashwaat Mountains''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The [[Jhanjaari River]] flowed out of the mountains toward the body of [[Water/Legends|water]] known as the [[Silver Sea/Legends|Silver Sea]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shashwaat Mountains were mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
